name: Phenazepam
summary: A very long-acting, potent, subtle benzodiazepine. Infamous for the calamitous experiences, many anectodal reports indicate the drugs suggestibility for redosing and reckless usage. The drug is prescribed in certain countries for epilepsy and alcohol withdrawal.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

uses.text: Phenazepam is used in the treatment of various mental disorders such schizophrenia and anxiety. It can be used as a premedication before surgery as it augments the effects of anesthetics. In 2009, phenazepam has gained popularity as a recreational drug; misuse has been reported in the United Kingdom, Finland, Sweden, and the United States.

sideEffects.text: Side effects include hiccups, dizziness, loss of coordination and drowsiness, along with anterograde amnesia which can be quite pronounced at high doses.

pharmacology.en: Like other benzodiazepines it acts at the benzodiazepine site of the GABA-A receptor, strengthening the effect of the brain's main calming neurotransmitter. It acts for a very long time.
pharmacology.zh: 與其他苯二氮平一樣，它作用於 GABA-A 受體的苯二氮平位點，增強大腦主要抑制性神經傳導物質的作用。它的作用時間非常長。
pharmacology.zhHans: 与其他苯二氮平一样，它作用于 GABA-A 受体的苯二氮平位点，增强大脑主要抑制性神经传导物质的作用。它的作用时间非常长。

fact.en: Phenazepam was developed in the Soviet Union in 1975 and was a prescription medicine there, which is unusual for a benzodiazepine that later became widely sold online.
fact.zh: 芬納西泮在 1975 年於蘇聯研發，並在當地作為處方藥使用；對一個後來在網路上廣泛販售的苯二氮平而言，這相當少見。
fact.zhHans: 芬纳西泮在 1975 年于苏联研发，并在当地作为处方药使用；对一个后来在网络上广泛贩售的苯二氮平而言，这相当少见。
